shot.camera: full-frame cinema camera, 35mm lens, smooth crane move, one continuous take, no cuts
shot.sequence: starts high above a forest looking straight down at the canopy and forest floor; dives slowly toward the ground, passing close to plants and wildflowers; softly decelerates just above the grass, then rises and tilts up to reveal a clearing with a glowing emblem sign, and behind it a misty valley with snow-capped mountains in the distance

scene.environment: lush alpine forest at sunrise: tall pines, green undergrowth, ferns, moss, colorful wildflowers
scene.ground: detailed forest floor with flowers, plants and soft morning dew
scene.atmosphere: thin morning mist between the trees, volumetric sunlight rays through the canopy, tiny pollen particles floating in the light

subject.object: a premium minimalist brand emblem sign standing in the clearing, like a high-end matte-black rounded monolith totem
subject.details: brushed metal, subtle reflections, tiny imperfections, warm golden sunrise rim light

effect.element: a subtle glowing cyan-blue sine waveform floating in front of the emblem sign
effect.behavior: gently pulsing like a calm voice visualization, soft glow, faint cyan light spill on the sign and nearby plants, elegant, never dominant, no neon

style: photorealistic real camera footage, luxury tech commercial; natural sunrise light, golden highlights, cool blue shadows, natural HDR, soft filmic contrast; premium cinematic grade, slightly desaturated; smooth, calm, premium
avoid: illustration, 3D render, CGI, cartoon, low-poly, vector art, neon, excessive bloom, oversaturated colors, flat lighting, text, watermark, UI elements, people, animals, camera shake, jerky motion
